welcome_message: Create a Skyulf training project. Choose single_model for one model, model_competition for 2-8 candidates sharing one target, or multi_target for 2-8 independent target branches. Choose quick setup to choose the task, source arrangement, tables, columns and monitoring destination, and accept the remaining documented defaults, or detailed setup to review each setting. Select single-node or Spark batch scoring based on expected rows and bytes per scoring run and available compute. Spark inference trains with pandas and requires partition-safe steps. Select models, ensemble members and training settings in setup; editable model-owned settings and Core-derived search spaces are generated automatically. Model eligibility, outputs and combined business rules live in config/scoring.yml; optional custom callbacks live in src/features/scoring.py. Initialization creates local files only.
